value.rationale: The complementary T(6)=L(K6) and KG(6,2) are natural canonical edge-intersection/disjointness networks. Basin sizes of every individual temporal attractor quantify nonlinear dynamics not specified by general period-two or static recurrent-classification theorems. Equal maximum relaxation time three and an exact factor 76/15 in oscillation-basin probability provide a motivated graph-complement contrast, even though the theorem is finite and has no claimed downstream generalization.
